column3: “Women” and “more” are supplied; husbands specifies masters.
Being cast out renders the active throwing.
The gift to people in cities becomes besetting the cities.
From city to city omits two or three cities going to one.
The abundance of gardens and vineyards is linked to the striking, rather than to the consuming pest.
“Plagues” is plural; captured horses are joined to those killed rather than to the capture of horses.
“Some of you” specifies among you; I replaces God in the comparison.
